newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices remained mostly steady on Wednesday amid slow activity, dealers said.
"It is kind of quiet. The (CBOT) board was down today and everybody is trying to see if this market will hold after its runup last week," a Kansas dealer said.
He added livestock were still on pastures and pastures have not dried up yet from the high temperatures.
Buffalo was being helped a bit by a little downtime coming at one of the mills next week which has scheduled repair work on Monday and Tuesday, a Buffalo dealer said.
He noted there was not much of a change in demand.
In North Carolina, the high temperatures continue and animals were backing off feed, a broker said.
One dealer said the tone of the market was much better than it was two weeks ago, despite the drop in CBOT corn and soybean prices.
